insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Rumble is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Rumble in 15/30 games (50%): 6 picks (2-4) and 9 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rumble? They go Sion
insights.text: Rumble is a G1 favorite (4/13 G1s, played by Fudge). In the 8 later games where it was burned or banned, Fudge went to Sion (3/8) and Renekton (2/8).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 4 G3+ games, 9/20 picks (45%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 39 champs in G1s, 18 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned
